description: This Java class defines a custom exception 'EntityNotFoundException' for handling cases where a requested entity is not found in the database. It extends a base exception class 'SimpleBankingGlobalException' and provides constructors to specify error messages.

classes.name: EntityNotFoundException
classes.description: A custom exception class indicating that a requested entity was not found in the database. It inherits from 'SimpleBankingGlobalException' and provides constructors for default and custom messages.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException()
methods.description: Default constructor that initializes the exception with a standard error message and error code indicating 'entity not found'.

methods.name: EntityNotFoundException(String message)
methods.description: Constructor that allows passing a custom error message while still assigning the 'entity not found' error code.
